voiceover_script: Kya aap jante hain ki Bajrangbali Hanuman aaj bhi is dharti par sadev upasthit hain? Sanatan parampara mein unhe Chiranjivi ka vardaan prapt hai. Hanuman Aaj Bhi Zinda Hain — Chiranjivi! ✨

🔱 Hanuman Chiranjivi immortal still alive Kali Yuga legend

Lord Hanuman is one of the seven Chiranjivis (immortals) in Sanatan Dharma, blessed by Mata Sita and Lord Rama to remain on Earth as long as the story of Rama is recited.

👉 Kya aapne kabhi Shri Ram ya Hanuman ji ki divya upasthiti ko anubhav kiya hai?
